title: SRD: a creature that is your friend (Friendly attitude) is your ally; engine: allies are only creatures on the same team, so a Friendly NPC never counts

history.summary:
Fixed T-87. The engine decided who counts as an ally only by team, so a Friendly NPC never counted. I added `Game.is_ally(a, b)` in `dungdra/game.py` and made `allies_of` use it. A creature is never its own ally (R-36). Creatures on the same team are allies (GLOSS.ally#1/#3). A creature whose attitude is Friendly toward the party is a party member's ally, and the party member is its ally too (GLOSS.ally#2, R-37). Every caller that uses `allies_of` now picks this up (Sneak Attack, Protection, Pack Tactics, the GM's flanking logic, turn help).

Results: the target test passes with `--runxfail`, and the unit tests pass (539, plus 5 new tests in `test_game`). `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` are clean, and dev-gate passes. In the full suite, the only failure is the T-87 test, which now passes unexpectedly while its strict xfail marker is still on. Running the other ally tests with `--runxfail`, T-88 (GM designation) and T-89 (Help on an enemy's ability check) still fail; they are separate tickets.

I left the separate team-equality check in `HelpAttack` (`dungdra/effects.py:350`) alone. No test or ticket here covers it.
